Riverside University Summer Research Programme 2027

The Riverside Summer Research Programme is an eight-week programme for undergraduate students in physics.
Eligibility: Applicants must be citizens or permanent residents of the United States. Students must have completed their second year.
Deadline: applications close on February 1, 2027.
Stipend: $6,000 for the eight weeks.
